title: Quick Scan Co-creation in Higher Education

contacts.name: M.M.  Kargól
contacts.affiliation: The Hague University of Applied Sciences

descriptions: In this tool co-creation is regarded as a collaborative process, where students, lecturers and working field professionals from outside the university jointly develop innovative products, processes or knowledge. In co-creation all stakeholders equally contribute to the collaborative process, and aims to create beneficial outcomes for each participant. Based on peerreviewed literatue, we developed a questionnaire to assess co-creation processes in HE. Students, lecturers and working field professionals (N=103) participating in co-creation projects completed the questionnaire. We validated the questionnaire using a principal component analysis. The seven extracted scales proved to be sufficiently reliable. The tool can be downloaded and freely used. We would greatly appreciate if teams of users could email their completed tool (anonimised) to the researcher for further research purposes to m.s.a.dehei@hhs.nl.
